title: Marty Cagan (SVPG · INSPIRED, EMPOWERED, TRANSFORMED), asked for a book recommendation — 'I think it's better than Lean Startup'
summary: Asked for a recent book recommendation during an AI Product Heroes Q&A, Marty Cagan names Incorruptible and says he thinks it is better than The Lean Startup. He explains why through the frustration that has followed him for a career: teams he helped get good at product kept becoming acquisition targets and getting hollowed out, which he had always assumed was unavoidable bad luck. The book changed that assumption.
blockquote: I do read a lot of books, maybe the last person, but Incorruptible — it's called Incorruptible, it's by Eric Ries, the guy that wrote Lean Startup, and it is a total surprise, that book. And I think it's better than Lean Startup.
blockquote_source: Marty Cagan on the AI Product Heroes Q&A (55:20)

source_urls.label: Cagan on why it landed — 'I always thought that was unavoidable, just bad luck… but I learned that there are actually things you can do to set up your company so that doesn't happen'
